intro: Shindrell's Note is a written missive detailing recent observations of corruption around Astranaar and the Ashenvale coastline. Penned by the night elf Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire, it serves as an intelligence report dispatched east across the forest to the druid Kayneth Stillwind.

p: As unrest spreads throughout Ashenvale, night elf sentinels and druids coordinate to monitor the woodland's borders. Penned by Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar, this report details troubling disturbances spotted along the western coast and through the central canopies. It is addressed to Kayneth Stillwind, a druid stationed at the shrine of Forest Song within the Nightsong Woods to the east. By dispatching couriers with her firsthand observations, Shindrell aids Kayneth's investigation into the subtle corruption creeping through the sacred groves.
